GAS ownership and PaperZD bridge

One combat stack; animation is an observer of accepted action state.

Player owner/avatar sequence

ARPGPlayerState owns the player URPGAbilitySystemComponent and URPGAttributeSet for possession/death continuity within one zone. The current ARPGPlayerCharacter is the avatar. Enemy ASC belongs on ARPGEnemyCharacter. Implement IAbilitySystemInterface on the chosen accessor path and return the same ASC, not a second component.

After possession on the server and after PlayerState replication on the owning client, call one guarded project initialization path that supplies PlayerState owner and current Character avatar to the installed ASC actor-info initialization API. Public engine name InitAbilityActorInfo is a mechanism to verify in installed headers; this document does not provide a compiled override signature. Bind input only after actor info and granted ability specs are ready.

On death/unpossession cancel transient abilities, unbind old avatar cues/input and prevent stale callbacks. On new possession reinitialize the avatar. Cross-server travel creates a new PlayerState/ASC and reconstructs durable ability/talent/cooldown state; the old ASC is not serialized and teleported.

Attributes, grants and prediction

Initial attributes and granted abilities are server-derived from class, level, equipment and durable skill allocations. Recompute derived values once through one rule path; do not apply equipment bonuses again in UI. Attribute changes replicate through the proper GAS attribute/RepNotify route; measure PlayerState update settings in two-client tests so HUD is not stale.

Begin with server-confirmed execution where prediction is uncertain. Introduce prediction keys for responsive cost/cooldown/cues only after rejection rollback is proven. A rejected predicted action removes its provisional cues/cost display and waits for authoritative attributes. Never let a client prediction key authorize an economy reward.

PaperZD bridge

Publish FRPGPresentationState with ActionId, tag, start/duration and facing to one sprite adapter. The adapter selects PaperZD sequences and layers. GAS does not automatically understand PaperZD flipbooks as skeletal montages. Avoid PlayMontageAndWait as a assumed sprite implementation; a project animation task may observe the adapter for cosmetics but server timing independently ends/cancels the ability.

Verify installed PaperZD instance/sequence callbacks and threading before writing exact API bindings. Notify-driven sounds/VFX are permitted. Damage, healing, cooldown release, gathering/catch/reward and inventory changes cannot depend on a notify arriving.

Two-client proof

A casts Cleave on an enemy while B observes. Server deducts cost once and validates hit; both see action/health. Reject A at insufficient stamina, cancel during cast, kill/repossess A, transfer A to another server, and repeat with missing animation notify. Confirm one ASC per owner, no duplicate grants and correct UI after reinitialization.
